observations.title: Pin a favorite world
observations.player_action: Click the empty star beside a world in the selection list.
observations.outcome: Bookmarked worlds stay at the top; multiple favorites retain ordering by last-played date.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Unpin before deleting a favorite
observations.player_action: Remove the bookmark before using the world's delete control.
observations.outcome: The favorite protects the world from deletion through that screen until it is unmarked.
conditions: This is client selection-screen behavior, not a backup or server-world protection system.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
